edits.before: He dives a point-and-click root with a shield behind it — survivable, if you hold W like it's your pulse.
edits.after: He swings into a point-and-click root — survivable, if you hold W like it's your pulse and ward the flanks.

edits.before: Root the dive, shield the burst, and out-scale him into irrelevance by two items. Every commit starts with one question: is Heroic Swing down?
edits.after: Root the dive, survive the burst, and out-scale him into irrelevance by two items. Every commit starts with one question: is Heroic Swing down?

edits.after: Skill

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online: the point-blank root answers his grapple. Even now — Q-W-Q when Heroic Swing is down, back off when it is up.

edits.before: Akshan
edits.after: Ryze

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks the flux combo and W punishes a mistimed Heroic Swing — level 3 is your window to E-Q every wave contact.

edits.after: Skill

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: Tear + Lost Chapter hums, his poke resets answer back — short-trade his wave contacts, walk before Avengerang returns.

edits.after: Akshan

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Comeuppance and swing mobility give him roam and reset tempo you cannot chase — shove and match roams, don't duel at 6.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Ryze

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.

edits.after: Ryze

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items and you outclass his pick kit: EQ deletes carries, W stops the swing, and Realm Warp ambushes objectives.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Rune Prison for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: 18s rank 1 — his engage and escape; step up only on its downtime. - Avengerang: 9s rank 1. - Comeuppance: 100s, missing-health damage the first minion hit absorbs — keep one between you.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: Going Rogue camouflages his flank — Control Wards and a sweeper are mandatory, and a centered wave shortens his angle.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: At half HP Comeuppance's missing-health barrage plus the swing dive kill you — the stacks are still there after a reset.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the thesis across the map. Nothing else fits Ryze.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots (Tear first back). RoA into Seraph's, then Rabadon's; Zhonya's vs dive. The mana items ARE the damage items — never skip the battery. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots (Tear first back). RoA into Seraph's, then Rabadon's; Zhonya's vs dive. The mana items ARE the damage items — never skip the battery. Zhonya's cancels a locked Comeuppance.

notes: Level chart moved on the full layer only; content win[] already matched the packet on all seven rows, so no win[] edits (no-ops would be rejected). Removed unverifiable claims: Ryze 'shield' and 'anti-heal into his sustain' (Akshan's passive is a shield, no healing in his kit text). Replacement claim 'Zhonya's cancels a locked Comeuppance' is standard stasis-vs-channel behaviour but the kit text does not state it — flagged as unverified for QA. Going Rogue camouflage warning added per missingInteractions. Ratings follow the observed convention that the number expresses how strongly the named side wins.
